inputs.label: Command & Conquer Generals: Zero Hour
inputs.help: Your installed Zero Hour, the folder with INIZH.big. Steam installs often hold the base game in a ZH_Generals subfolder; keep it. CD or ISO editions must be installed first.

inputs.label: Command & Conquer Generals (base game)
inputs.help: Only if your Zero Hour folder has no ZH_Generals subfolder: the installed base game, with Terrain.big, Textures.big and W3D.big.

steps.text: Do not uninstall an earlier build of Generals: Zero Hour XR. Updating over it keeps your settings and game folder choice.

steps.why: The setup assistant asks for file access.

steps.text: Open Generals: Zero Hour XR and allow file access. In the setup assistant, choose /sdcard/Download/GeneralsZH as the Zero Hour folder. If it cannot find the base game, pick /sdcard/Download/Generals. Confirm with Use these folders and play.

notes: The guide copies the whole Zero Hour folder to /sdcard/Download/GeneralsZH as an example; any folder works. The separate base game folder name is a choice. The APK needs about 250 MB plus the game data; the data size is not given, so no freeSpaceMB. Steam is the tested store; no app ID is set. Releases are named -xr-preview but are not marked as pre-releases.
